title: Regenerative medical technology at underground lab near El Paso
place_text: Underground lab on the Mexican-American border, El Paso, Texas

tellings.quote: I've seen some technologies at a underground lab on the Mexican American border really El Paso that you can regrow a limb.

plain: Somewhere under the ground on the US-Mexico border near El Paso, Texas, there is a laboratory with medical technology that can make a lost limb grow back. This comes from Steven Greer, a man who argues that UFO secrets are held by a hidden global group. He tells Michels he saw these technologies himself, which, if true, would mean healing far beyond anything doctors have in public is being kept out of sight.
